name: Akaneiro no Shoujo
source:
A girl suffers from an incurable disease. From youkai research organization she gets information that the source of her illness lies in the mysterious town of San'in. Girl sets off there alone. Will she overcome numerous difficulties and return safely?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩患有不治之症。她从妖怪研究组织得知，她的病源位于神秘的山阴小镇。女孩独自出发去那里。她能否克服重重困难，平安归来？
